email.subject: A couple quick fixes for Tidewater's site
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I was looking at local HVAC sites in Harbor Falls and checked yours. Two things are likely costing you calls: there are no customer reviews showing anywhere, and your hours aren't listed, so people searching "HVAC near me open now" can't tell if you're open and probably call a competitor instead. The homepage images are also oversized, which slows load time on mobile.

I fix these kinds of issues for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what I'd change and why? No obligation either way.

Alex
